name: cloud-finops
description: Analyse AWS, Azure and Google Cloud bills from a FOCUS cost export, the open billing format all three publish. Three deterministic stdlib scripts: an allocation check that measures the share of EffectiveCost carrying your required tags, lists the largest unallocated resources and flags tag values that split one owner; a commitment check for Savings Plans, Reserved Instances and committed use discounts that computes utilization, coverage in on-demand equivalent and the FinOps Foundation effective savings rate, refuses to recommend buying while commitments sit idle and sizes new ones to the uncovered floor; and a robust anomaly detector with unit-cost tracking. Ships cs-finops-analyst agent, /cs-finops-review and /cs-cost-spike commands and 3 cited references. No cloud credentials, read-only.
